title: Posterior Uncertainty for Targeted Parameters in Bayesian Bootstrap Procedures
summary: We propose a general method to carry out a valid Bayesian analysis of a finite-dimensional `targeted' parameter in the presence of a finite-dimensional nuisance parameter. We apply our methods to causal inference based on estimating equations. While much of the literature in Bayesian causal inference has relied on the conventional 'likelihood times prior' framework, a recently proposed method, the 'Linked Bayesian Bootstrap', deviated from this classical setting to obtain valid Bayesian inference using the Dirichlet process and the Bayesian bootstrap.
